claim_title: Scale-Dependent Emergence of Personal and Attributed Belief

figures.caption: Behavioral scaling of world_knowledge / personal_belief / attributed_belief across pythia-{410m, 1b, 2.8b} — Wilson 95% CI. The smallest model handles personal belief above chance (0.85) but fails attributed belief entirely (0.46, below chance). Personal-belief accuracy is non-monotonic across scales.
